title: LLM isolation: a profile cannot ask for in-process subagents on a family whose manifest lacks inprocess_subagents
summary: Item isolation-dispatch-request-channel declared the manifest capability inprocess_subagents (claude-p, claude-tmux), but no code reads it (llm-isolation.md §7.2, §7.2.1 known differences). The architecture review of that PR (round 3, HIGH) named the declared field with no reader.
fix: Read bridge.CapabilityInprocessSubagents at the launch of a profile: a profile whose allowed_tools grant Task or Agent on a CLI without the capability is refused, or the grant is dropped with a signal. Decide the stage (shadow first). Measure which harnesses (codex, agy) run subagents in their own process before they declare the capability.
acceptance: RED first: a profile with Task allowed on a CLI with no inprocess_subagents launches with no refusal and no signal
The launch refuses the grant at enforce and emits a signal at shadow
Changed functions at 100% coverage; llm-isolation.md §7.2 updated
source: console, 2026-10-27, follow-up of item isolation-dispatch-request-channel (architecture review round 3, finding 2)
